hold_text: Adds a Tier-2 system-action (install-web-api-deps) that pip-installs the fixed package webauthn into the interpreter ict-web-api.service actually runs and restarts that unit. Touches no order path, strategies, accounts or risk.
why: POST /api/auth/passkey/register/begin 500s with ModuleNotFoundError: webauthn because deploy_pull_restart.sh pip-installs into /usr/bin/python3 while the web-api runs from the repo .venv, so the operator cannot enrol a passkey. The action reads the spec from requirements.txt, takes no free-form input, verifies the import, then restarts. Root cause tracked as DEPLOY-PIP-VENV. Tests: tests/ops/test_system_actions_workflow.py, tests/ops/test_web_auth_config_actions.py.
